title: Bubbles
description: Adds a few new bubble consumables.
body:
**Bubbles** adds new bubble consumable items that have various effects and make a nice pop sound. Any help with the textures would be nice, as currently they don't look spectacular. ## Features I'm too lazy to make recipe unlocks, so refer to here for recipes.
Bubble ![Bubble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3cf5ab00f54a11a2522bb44273a87079b668138e.png) **Bubble** item that grants _Speed I_ for 30s. 4x Bubbles crafted with **1 Water Bucket** and **1 [Rod-shaped item](## "Stick, Any Arrow, Blaze/Breeze Rod and Bones")**. ![Bubble Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/944d5cfc2ba5afa4fa26a3819000b628e16088ff.gif)
Golden Bubble ![Golden Bubble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc4376634a98005655097da66c7911290260cc76.png) **Golden Bubble** item that grants _Regeneration II_ for 5s and _Absorption III_ for 1m20s. 6x Golden Bubbles crafted with **4 Gold Ingots**, **4 Gold Nuggets** and **1 Bubble**. ![Golden Bubble Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/775bb33caf3f7619aebb2e76bd868a2ec8160ccc.png)
Chemical Bubble ![Chemical Bubble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/230edf4f0127826aad7f938c42116fedd26b7f97.png) **Chemical Bubble** item that grants _Haste II_ and _Water Breathing_ for 30s. Crafted with **4 Iron Nuggets**, **2 Feathers**, **1 Sugar**, **1 Blaze Powder** and **1 Bubble**. ![Chemical Bubble Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/485858d9620920ba6eb0fd96ff3f196232057dfd.png)
Aqual Bubble ![Aqual Bubble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a2cbbc84f867170c120c075daef12060f3cd862.png) **Aqual Bubble** item that grants _Conduit Power_ and _Dolphin's Grace_ for 45s. 10x Aqual Bubbles crafted with **6 Iron Nuggets**, **1 Heart of the Sea**, **1 Snowball** and **1 Bubble**. ![Aqual Bubble Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f0a574da42dcc2b5f0a03e409a29f471f24b19e.png)
Blood Bubble ![Blood Bubble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fcc5d76ea1e8ea89136f68476a57953b690e369.png) **Blood Bubble** item that grants _Strength II_ for 1m. 10x Blood Bubbles crafted with **6 Gold Nuggets**, **1 Fire Charge**, **1 Resin Clump** and **1 Bubble**. ![Blood Bubble Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5907652bfb60493261a57a736e426dcb34426c4.png)
Verdant Bubble ![Verdant Bubble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04f4459505eed2bd344e02762e3b3704b6dfa451.png) **Verdant Bubble** item that grants _Haste I_, _Dolphin's Grace_ and _Luck I_ for 1m. 10x Verdant Bubbles crafted with **6 Bamboo**, **1 Sugar Cane**, **1 Slimeball** and **1 Bubble**. ![Verdant Bubble Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e096e57f1068e43086fbd74e87bb7a63de26632c.png)
Copper Bubble ![Copper Bubble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/173295256ea38f22501633538f3ceea9208f5200.png) **Copper Bubble** item that grants _Haste I_, _Dolphin's Grace_ and _Luck I_ for 1m. 6x Copper Bubbles crafted with **8 Copper Ingots** and **1 Bubble**. ![Copper Bubble Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f36c2ec688d041cc0ada396b4dec515f064f7169.png)
